$comment: Verbatim extraction from https://primer.style (GitHub Primer) marketing + docs CSS. Do not remap — values are copied verbatim from the live CSS. Source URLs listed in "source".

source.note: All --*: value; assignments extracted via regex /--[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\s*:\s*[^;{}]+;/ on the concatenated _next/static/chunks/*.css stylesheets. First occurrence per name kept (light-mode value where duplicated); dark-mode overrides ([data-color-mode=dark]) are not flattened here.

brand.--brand-CTABanner-color-logo-filter-mute: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(37%) sepia(7%) saturate(778%) hue-rotate(171deg) brightness(96%) contrast(91%)
brand.--brand-Label-gradient-conical: conic-gradient(from 90deg at center, var(--brand-Label-color-stop-1) 0deg, var(--brand-Label-color-stop-2) 160deg, var(--brand-Label-color-stop-3) 175deg, var(--brand-Label-color-stop-4) 200deg, var(--brand-Label-color-stop-4) 350deg, var(--brand-Label-color-stop-1) 360deg)
brand.--brand-Label-gradient-radial: radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--brand-Label-color-start), var(--brand-Label-color-end))
brand.--brand-LogoSuite-color-logo-filter-mute: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(37%) sepia(7%) saturate(778%) hue-rotate(171deg) brightness(96%) contrast(91%)
brand.--brand-animation-transition-default: opacity var(--brand-animation-duration-default) var(--brand-animation-easing-default), transform var(--brand-animation-duration-default) var(--brand-animation-easing-default)
brand.--brand-fontStack-sansSerif: "Mona Sans", "MonaSansFallback", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
brand.--brand-fontStack-sansSerifAlt: "Hubot Sans", "Hubot SansHeaderFallback", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
brand.--brand-fontStack-system: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"

blankslate.--blankslate-description-text: var(--text-body-shorthand-large,400 1rem/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji")
blankslate.--blankslate-heading-text: var(--text-title-shorthand-medium,600 1.25rem/1.625 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji")

fontStack.--fontStack-monospace: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

fontStack.--fontStack-sansSerifDisplay: "Mona Sans VF", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Backtick Fix", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
fontStack.--fontStack-system: "Mona Sans VF", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Backtick Fix", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
